rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the “Act on the Management of Marriage Brokerage Businesses” and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the “Act on the Management of Marriage Brokerage Businesses” and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 1-2 (Contents and Methods of Fact-Finding Survey, etc.) ① The fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 2-2 of the Act on the Management of Marriage Brokerage Businesses (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)shall include the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 14, 2018; October 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Contents and Methods of Fact-Finding Survey, etc.) ① The fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 2-2 of the Act on the Management of Marriage Brokerage Businesses (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall include the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 14, 2018; October 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. Matters concerning the current status and operational conditions of the marriage brokerage business
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the current status and operational conditions of the marriage brokerage business

rows.source_ko: 2. Matters concerning the general characteristics of the user of the marriage brokerage service and the counterparty, such as nationality, gender, age, educational background, and employment status
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the general characteristics of the user of the marriage brokerage service and the counterparty, such as nationality, gender, age, educational background, and employment status

rows.source_ko: 3. Matters concerning the actual state of marital life, such as duration of marriage, marital status, and satisfaction with marital life
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the actual state of marital life, such as duration of marriage, marital status, and satisfaction with marital life

rows.source_ko: 4. Matters concerning damages suffered by users of marriage brokerage services and their counterparts, including causes of damage, types of damage, and damage relief.
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning damages suffered by users of marriage brokerage services and their counterparts, including causes of damage, types of damage, and damage relief.

rows.source_ko: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family in relation to understanding the actual status of marriages through marriage brokerage businesses
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family in relation to understanding the actual status of marriages through marriage brokerage businesses

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Gender Equality and Family Affairs may commission the fact-finding survey under Paragraph 1 to a research institution, corporation, or organization equipped with expertise, personnel, and equipment regarding marriage and family systems, etc. <Amended Jun. 14, 2018; Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Gender Equality and Family Affairs may commission the fact-finding survey under Paragraph 1 to a research institution, corporation, or organization equipped with expertise, personnel, and equipment regarding marriage and family systems, etc. <Amended Jun. 14, 2018; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Reporting of Domestic Marriage Brokerage Business) ①Any person who intends to report a domestic marriage brokerage business pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a report form in Annex No. 1 (including a report form in the form of an electronic document) accompanied by the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor ( including the Mayor of an Administrative City pursuant to the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of an International Free City; hereinafter the same applies), County Governor, or District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district; hereinafter the same applies) having jurisdiction over the location of the principal brokerage office. In this case, if there are two or more brokerage offices, a report form must be submitted for each brokerage office. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Aug. 2, 2012; Feb. 5, 2014; Dec. 27, 2016; Jun. 14, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Reporting of Domestic Marriage Brokerage Business) ① Any person who intends to report a domestic marriage brokerage business pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a report form in Annex No. 1 (including a report form in the form of an electronic document) accompanied by the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor (including the Mayor of an Administrative City pursuant to the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of an International Free City; hereinafter the same applies), County Governor, or District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district; hereinafter the same applies) having jurisdiction over the location of the principal brokerage office. In this case, if there are two or more brokerage offices, a report form must be submitted for each brokerage office. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Aug. 2, 2012; Feb. 5, 2014; Dec. 27, 2016; Jun. 14, 2018>

rows.text_en: Article 4 (Registration of International Marriage Brokerage Business) ① A person who intends to register an international marriage brokerage business pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a registration application in the form of Annex No. 1 (including a registration application in the form of an electronic document) to the Special Self-Governing City Mayor, City Mayor, County Governor, or District Head having jurisdiction over the location of the principal brokerage office, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. rows.source_ko: ② 법 제4조제1항 후단에 따라 변경등록을 하려는 자는 별지 제4호서식의 변경신청서(전자문서로 된 변경신청서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2018. 6. 14., 2019. 10. 18.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to register a change pursuant to the latter part of Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for change in the form of Annex No. 4 (including an application for change in the form of an electronic document) to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head, attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Jun. 14, 2018; Oct. 18, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 등록증
rows.text_en: 1. Registration certificate

rows.source_ko: 2. 변경사항을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving the changes

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제5호서식의 행정처분 내용 고지 확인서(양도ㆍ양수 또는 합병으로 인한 변경만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Confirmation of Notification of Administrative Disposition Details ( Form No. 5 ) (Applicable only to changes due to transfer, acquisition, or merger)

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 변경신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 등록증을 고쳐 쓴 후 발급하거나 재발급하여야 한다. 이 경우 특별자치시ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구를 달리하는 중개사무소의 소재지 변경을 이유로 변경신청을 받았을 때에는 종전의 중개사무소를 관리하는 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장으로부터 제4조제1항 및 제3항에 따른 등록서류 전부를 송부받아 기록ㆍ관리하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2018. 6. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head who receives an application for change pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall amend the registration certificate and issue or reissue it. In this case, when an application for change is received on the grounds of a change in the location of a brokerage office in a different Special Self-Governing City, City, County, or District, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head managing the former brokerage office shall receive all registration documents pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 3 of Article 4 and record and manage them. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Jun. 14, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(신고필증 또는 등록증의 재발급) 결혼중개업자는 신고필증 또는 등록증을 잃어버렸거나 헐어 못쓰게 되어 재발급을 받으려는 경우에는 별지 제7호서식의 신고필증 또는 등록증 재발급신청서(전자문서로 된 신청서를 포함한다)에 그 신고필증 또는 등록증을 첨부(신고필증 또는 등록증이 헐어 못쓰게 된 경우만 해당한다)하여 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 신청하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2017. 7. 13., 2018. 6. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Reissuance of Certificate of Reporting or Registration) If a marriage brokerage business operator wishes to obtain a reissuance of a Certificate of Reporting or Registration because it has been lost or is worn out and unusable, the operator shall apply to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head by attaching the said Certificate of Reporting or Registration to the Application for Reissuance of Certificate of Reporting or Registration (Form No. 7) (including applications submitted as electronic documents) (applicable only in cases where the Certificate of Reporting or Registration is worn out and unusable). <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Jul. 13, 2017; Jun. 14, 2018>
1. Deleted <July 13, 2017>
2. Deleted <July 13, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2(결혼중개업체의 공시) 법 제4조의2제1항에 따라 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 매월 15일까지 전월 말을 기준으로 별지 제7호의2서식의 결혼중개업체 공시에 다음 각 호의 사항을 해당 특별자치시ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구의 인터넷 홈페이지에 공시하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 8. 4., 2018. 6. 14., 2021. 1. 8., 2025. 9. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 6-2 (Public Disclosure of Marriage Brokerage Agencies) Pursuant to Article 4-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall, by the 15th of each month, publicly disclose the matters in each of the following subparagraphs on the internet homepage of the relevant Special Self-Governing City, City, County, or District, in accordance with the public disclosure of marriage brokerage agencies in Form No. 7-2 of the Attached Form, based on the end of the previous month. <Amended Aug. 4, 2015; Jun. 14, 2018; Jan. 8, 2021; Sep. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 결혼중개업체의 현황에 관한 다음 각 목의 사항
rows.text_en: 1. The following matters regarding the current status of marriage brokerage agencies

rows.source_ko: 가. 상호명
rows.text_en: A. Business Name

rows.source_ko: 나. 대표자 성명(법인의 경우에는 법인명 및 대표자 성명)
rows.text_en: B. Name of the representative (in the case of a corporation, the name of the corporation and the name of the representative)

rows.source_ko: 다. 신고일 또는 등록일
rows.text_en: C. Date of report or registration

rows.source_ko: 라. 소재지(「도로명주소법」 제2조제7호에 따른 도로명주소로 한다)
rows.text_en: D. Location ( shall be the road name address pursuant to Article 2, Item 7 of the Road Name Address Act )

rows.source_ko: 마. 전화번호
rows.text_en: E. Phone number

rows.source_ko: 바. 인터넷 홈페이지 주소(인터넷 홈페이지를 운영하는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: f. Internet homepage address (applicable only if an internet homepage is operated)

rows.source_ko: 사. 영업, 폐업 또는 휴업 여부
rows.text_en: G. Whether business is operating, closed, or suspended

rows.source_ko: 2. 결혼중개업체의 최근 3년 이내 영업정지 이상의 행정처분 및 과태료 처분에 관한 다음 각 목의 사항
rows.text_en: 2. The following matters concerning administrative sanctions of suspension of business or higher, and administrative fines imposed on marriage brokerage firms within the last three years

rows.source_ko: 가. 처분일자
rows.text_en: a. Date of disposition

rows.source_ko: 나. 처분내용
rows.text_en: B. Details of the Disposition

[This Article was newly established on Aug. 2, 2012]
[Title amended on June 14, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제6조의3(지도점검) 법 제4조의3제2항에 따라 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 국제결혼중개업에 대한 연간 지도점검 계획을 수립ㆍ시행하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 6. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 6-3 (Supervision and Inspection) Pursuant to Article 4-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head shall formulate and implement an annual supervision and inspection plan for international marriage brokerage businesses. <Amended June 14, 2018>
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 2, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제7조(휴업ㆍ폐업 및 재개업의 신고) ① 결혼중개업자는 법 제5조제1항에 따라 휴업(결혼중개업의 신고 또는 등록 후 영업을 시작하지 아니하는 경우를 포함한다. 이하 같다) 또는 폐업하거나 휴업 후 영업을 재개하려는 때에는 미리 별지 제8호서식의 휴업ㆍ폐업ㆍ재개업 신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2015. 8. 4., 2018. 6. 14., 2019. 10. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Reporting of Suspension, Closure, and Resumption of Business) ① In accordance with Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act , when a marriage brokerage business operator intends to suspend business (including cases where business does not commence after reporting or registering the marriage brokerage business; hereinafter the same applies) or close business, or to resume business after suspension, the operator shall submit a report on suspension, closure, or resumption of business in the form of Annex No. 8, attached with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head in advance. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Aug. 4, 2015; Jun. 14, 2018; Oct. 18, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 신고필증 또는 등록증 1부. 다만, 신고필증 또는 등록증을 잃어버린 경우에는 분실사유서(폐업신고만 해당한다)를 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Certificate of Report or Registration. However, if the Certificate of Report or Registration is lost, a statement of the reason for the loss must be submitted (applicable only to a report of business closure).

rows.source_ko: 2. 이용자에 대한 조치계획서 1부(영업의 재개인 경우는 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the action plan for users (excluding cases of business resumption)

rows.source_ko: 3. 제11조 각 호에 따른 종사자 명부 및 회원 명부 1부(폐업인 경우에만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of the employee roster and membership roster pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 11 (applicable only in the case of business closure)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 결혼중개업의 재개 신고를 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 신고필증 또는 등록증을 해당 결혼중개업자에게 즉시 반환하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2018. 6. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head who receives a report on the resumption of a marriage brokerage business pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall immediately return the certificate of report or the certificate of registration to the relevant marriage brokerage business operator. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Jun. 14, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따라 폐업신고를 하려는 자가 「부가가치세법」 제8조제8항에 따른 폐업신고를 같이 하려는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 폐업신고서에 「부가가치세법 시행규칙」 별지 제9호서식의 폐업신고서를 함께 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 함께 제출받은 폐업신고서를 지체 없이 관할 세무서장에게 송부(정보통신망을 이용한 송부를 포함한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)하여야 한다. <신설 2016. 7. 12., 2018. 6. 14., 2019. 10. 18., 2025. 9. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ If a person intending to file a report of business closure pursuant to Paragraph 1 also intends to file a report of business closure pursuant to Article 8 , Paragraph 8 of the Value Added Tax Act, they shall submit the report of business closure in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Enforcement Rules of the Value Added Tax Act together with the report of business closure pursuant to Paragraph 1. In this case, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall send the report of business closure received together to the head of the competent tax office without delay (including sending via an information and communications network; hereinafter the same applies in this Article). <Newly added July 12, 2016; June 14, 2018; October 18, 2019; September 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 관할 세무서장이 「부가가치세법 시행령」 제13조제5항에 따라 제1항에 따른 폐업신고를 받아 이를 해당 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에 송부한 경우에는 제1항에 따른 폐업신고서가 제출된 것으로 본다. <신설 2016. 7. 12., 2018. 6. 14.>
rows.text_en: ④ Where the competent tax office receives a report of business closure under Paragraph 1 pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Value Added Tax Act and forwards it to the relevant Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head, the report of business closure under Paragraph 1 shall be deemed to have been submitted. <Newly added July 12, 2016; June 14, 2018>
[Title amended Nov. 17, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(신고필증 등의 게시) ① 법 제8조제1항에서 “성평등가족부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 보증보험 증권을 말한다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2010. 11. 17., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Posting of Certificate of Registration, etc.) ① In Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act , “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry for Gender Equality and Family” refers to a guarantee insurance policy. <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Nov. 17, 2010; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 결혼중개업자는 법 제8조제1항에 따른 게시사항을 중개사무소의 규모 및 특성에 따라 부착하는 등의 방법으로 이용자가 쉽게 확인할 수 있도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Marriage brokerage business operators shall ensure that users can easily check the postings pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act by methods such as attaching them according to the size and characteristics of the brokerage office.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제8조제2항에서 “성평등가족부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2010. 3. 19., 2010. 11. 17., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry for Gender Equality and Family” refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 19, 2010; Nov. 17, 2010; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 상호와 대표자의 성명
rows.text_en: 1. Company Name and Representative's Name

rows.source_ko: 2. 신고번호 또는 등록번호
rows.text_en: 2. Report number or registration number

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업자등록번호
rows.text_en: 3. Business Registration Number

rows.source_ko: 4. 중개사무소 소재지의 주소 및 전화번호
rows.text_en: 4. Address and telephone number of the brokerage office

rows.source_ko: 5. 결혼중개업 수수료ㆍ회비 등을 기재한 표
rows.text_en: 5. Table listing marriage brokerage fees, membership fees, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 이용약관
rows.text_en: 6. Terms of Use

rows.source_ko: 7. 보증보험에 의한 손해배상 청구절차
rows.text_en: 7. Procedure for Claiming Damages Under Guarantee Insurance

rows.source_ko: ④ 인터넷 홈페이지를 운영하는 결혼중개업자는 법 제8조제2항에 따라 제3항 각 호의 사항을 이용자가 알아보기 쉽도록 인터넷 홈페이지 초기 화면에 표시하여야 한다. 다만, 제3항제5호부터 제7호까지의 사항은 이용자가 연결화면을 통하여 볼 수 있도록 할 수 있다. <개정 2014. 2. 5.>
rows.text_en: ④ A marriage brokerage business operator operating an internet homepage shall, in accordance with Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Act , display the matters specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 3 on the initial screen of the internet homepage so that users can easily recognize them. However, the matters under subparagraphs 5 through 7 of Paragraph 3 may be made available to users through a linked screen. <Amended Feb. 5, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(결혼중개계약서 등의 기록보존) 결혼중개업자는 법 제10조제3항 및 제10조의4제1항에 따라 작성한 서류를 5년 동안 보존하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Preservation of Records of Marriage Brokerage Contracts, etc.) A marriage brokerage business operator shall preserve documents prepared in accordance with Article 10, Paragraph 3 and Article 10-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act for five years.
[Wholly Amended Aug. 2, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의2(신상정보의 제공) ① 「결혼중개업의 관리에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영” 이라 한다) 제3조의2제1항제4호에 따른 범죄경력조회 신청서 및 범죄경력조회 회신서는 각각 별지 제8호의2서식 및 별지 제8호의3서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-2 (Provision of Personal Information) ① The application for criminal record check and the response to the criminal record check pursuant to Article 3-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Management of Marriage Brokerage Business (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in the form of Annex 8-2 and Annex 8-3, respectively.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제3조의2제2항에 따른 국제결혼 개인신상정보 확인서는 별지 제8호의4서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The confirmation of personal information for international marriage pursuant to Article 3-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 8-4 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제3조의2제3항에 따른 이용자와 상대방이 만남에 동의하는 서면동의서는 별지 제8호의5서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The written consent form in which the user and the other party agree to a meeting pursuant to Article 3-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 8-5 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Aug. 2, 2012]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의3(통역ㆍ번역서비스의 제공) ① 국제결혼중개업자는 법 제10조의3에 따라 통역ㆍ번역서비스를 제공하는 때에는 직접 또는 통역ㆍ번역 전문업체를 이용하여 통역ㆍ번역서비스를 제공할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-3 (Provision of Interpretation and Translation Services) ① When an international marriage broker provides interpretation and translation services pursuant to Article 10-3 of the Act , the broker may provide the interpretation and translation services either directly or by using a specialized interpretation and translation agency.

rows.source_ko: ② 국제결혼중개업자가 이용자에게 통역ㆍ번역서비스를 제공하는 때에는 국어로 제공함을 원칙으로 하고, 이용자가 지정한 언어가 따로 있는 경우에는 그 언어로 제공할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② When an international marriage broker provides interpretation and translation services to a user, it shall, in principle, provide them in the Korean language; however, if the user has designated a different language, the services may be provided in that language.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국제결혼중개업자가 결혼중개의 상대방에게 통역ㆍ번역서비스를 제공하는 때에는 상대방 국가의 언어로 제공함을 원칙으로 하고, 상대방이 지정한 언어가 따로 있는 경우에는 그 언어로 제공할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ When an international marriage broker provides interpretation and translation services to a counterparty to a marriage brokerage, it shall, in principle, provide them in the language of the counterparty's country; however, if the counterparty has designated a specific language, the services may be provided in that language.
[This Article Newly Inserted Nov. 17, 2010]

rows.source_ko: 제10조(거짓ㆍ과장된 표시ㆍ광고의 범위 등) 법 제12조제5항에 따른 거짓ㆍ과장된 표시ㆍ광고의 범위는 별표 1과 같다. 이 경우 표시란 결혼중개서비스에 관하여 이용자에게 알리기 위하여 중개사무소 등의 게시물 또는 회원권 등에 쓰거나 붙인 것을 말하며, 광고란 결혼중개서비스에 관한 사항을 정기간행물, 인터넷신문, 방송, 전기통신이나 그 밖의 수단을 통하여 일반인에게 알리거나 제시하는 것을 말한다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2012. 8. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Scope of False or Exaggerated Labeling and Advertising, etc.) The scope of false or exaggerated labeling and advertising pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 5 of the Act is as set forth in Attached Table 1. In this case, "labeling" refers to writing or affixing to postings or membership cards, etc., at brokerage offices, etc., to inform users of marriage brokerage services, and "advertising" refers to informing or presenting matters concerning marriage brokerage services to the general public through periodicals, internet newspapers, broadcasting, telecommunications, or other means. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Aug. 2, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(장부 등의 비치) 결혼중개업자는 법 제14조에 따라 다음 각 호의 장부ㆍ대장(전자문서로 된 장부ㆍ대장으로 갈음할 수 있다)을 작성하여 5년 동안 갖추어 두어야 한다. 다만, 장부ㆍ대장의 서식이 해당 사업에 적합하지 아니한 경우에는 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장의 승인을 받아 변경하여 사용할 수 있다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2012. 8. 2., 2018. 6. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Keeping of Books, etc.) Pursuant to Article 14 of the Act, a marriage brokerage business operator shall prepare the books and ledgers set forth in each of the following subparagraphs (which may be substituted with books and ledgers in the form of electronic documents) and keep them for five years. However, if the format of the books and ledgers is not suitable for the relevant business, they may be modified and used with the approval of the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Aug. 2, 2012; Jun. 14, 2018>

rows.text_en: Article 11-2 (Reporting of Marriage Brokerage Performance, etc.) An international marriage brokerage business operator shall report the marriage brokerage performance, etc. of the previous year pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Act to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head by January 31 of the following year, in accordance with Form No. 11 of the Attached Form. <Amended June 14, 2018>
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 2, 2012]

rows.text_en: Article 12 (Standards for Administrative Dispositions) The detailed standards for administrative dispositions pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(신고필증 등의 반납) ① 영 제5조제1항에 따라 등록증 또는 신고필증을 반납하려는 자는 등록취소 처분, 영업소 폐쇄명령 또는 영업정지명령을 받은 날부터 7일 이내에 등록증 또는 신고필증을 반납하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2015. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Return of Certificate of Report, etc.) ① Any person who intends to return a certificate of registration or a certificate of report pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall return the certificate of registration or the certificate of report within 7 days from the date of receiving the disposition of cancellation of registration, order to close a business premises, or order to suspend business operations. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Aug. 4, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제18조제1항에 따라 등록취소 처분, 영업소 폐쇄명령 또는 영업정지명령을 받은 경우로서 결혼중개업을 수행해 온 법인이 해산한 경우에는 그 법인의 대표자였던 자가 등록취소 처분, 영업소 폐쇄명령 또는 영업정지명령을 받은 날부터 7일 이내에 등록증 또는 신고필증을 반납하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: ② In the event that a corporation engaged in marriage brokerage business is dissolved while a disposition of registration cancellation, an order to close a business office, or an order to suspend business operations has been received pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the person who was the representative of said corporation shall return the registration certificate or the certificate of notification within 7 days from the date of receiving the disposition of registration cancellation, the order to close a business office, or the order to suspend business operations. <Amended Aug. 4, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(행정처분 및 청문대장) 특별자치시장ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제18조 및 법 제19조에 따라 행정처분을 한 경우와 법 제20조에 따라 청문을 한 경우에는 별지 제12호서식의 행정처분 및 청문대장에 그 내용을 기록ㆍ관리하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 11. 17., 2016. 7. 12., 2018. 6. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Register of Administrative Dispositions and Hearings) Where an administrative disposition has been issued pursuant to Articles 18 and 19 of the Act, or where a hearing has been held pursuant to Article 20 of the Act, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall record and manage the details thereof in the Register of Administrative Dispositions and Hearings in the Attached Form No. 12. <Amended Nov. 17, 2010; Jul. 12, 2016; Jun. 14, 2018>

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Applicability to Submission of Confirmation of Notification of Administrative Disposition)  Among those who filed a report of change or applied for a change of registration of a marriage brokerage business due to transfer, acquisition, or merger before the enforcement of this rule, those who have not received a certificate of report or a certificate of registration at the time of enforcement of this rule must submit a confirmation of notification of the administrative disposition in accordance with the amended provisions of Article 3, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3, Article 5, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3 and Form No. 5 of the attached document.
